about_the_game:
The Supporter Pack is a way for fans who want to go the extra mile to directly contribute to the game's ongoing development.

This cosmetic-only DLC doesn't give you any gameplay advantages — it simply adds some cool flair.

The Supporter Pack includes:

  • Flagpole with Switchable Flags: Personalize your base with a unique flagpole and a variety of flags to choose from, showcasing your style in the zombie apocalypse.

  • Two Pet Dogs: Pick from two adorable dog companions that will hang out in your base. They don't fight zombies, but they'll keep you company on your deadly journey.

  • Original Soundtrack: Get the fantastic official soundtrack, perfect for listening to the memorable tunes of Deadly Days: Roadtrip even when you're not playing.

Your purchase of the Supporter Pack helps us continue to add new content and features to the game. Thanks again for being an awesome part of our community!
